question: From which direction and into how many parts should the regional division be made?
premises: The starting point is the northern part.
The division should be made into nine parts.
The object is the regional division.
inference: Beginning from the northern part, one should make the regional division into nine parts.
uncertainties: The precise technical sense of varṣakam depends on the cosmographic context.
plain_english: Beginning from the northern part, make the regional division into nine parts.
